name: aider_code
description: Build new features for Odysseus by talking to it. Describe a function you want and Aider (free, git-aware, BYO local model) writes the real code, returning the git diff for you to review. Defaults to the Odysseus repo itself — that's the whole point. Auto-branches off main so a draft never disturbs the running app. Can be pointed at other projects too.

settings.label: Project path (the repo Aider may edit)
Auto-branch off main (safety: never edit main directly)
